prompt: A neighbor writes about the long interview: “Mina says, ‘We closed the shop before the rain.’ I remember staying out longer that day.” Which edit would fit the weekly comments sheet?
promptZh: 一位鄰居寫下對長訪談的回應：「米娜說：『我們在下雨前就收店了。』我記得那天我在外頭待得更久。」哪項編法符合每週意見單的用途？

options.text: Under the interview title, print ‘We closed the shop before the rain, but I stayed out longer’ as a single quotation from Mina.
options.zh: 在訪談標題下，把「我們在下雨前就收店了，但我在外頭待得更久」整段當成米娜的引言刊登。
options.whyZh: 前半句是米娜的話，後半句是鄰居的回憶，不能全當成米娜說的。

options.text: Print both statements under the interview title as a single unsigned comment without distinguishing the two accounts.
options.zh: 把兩段話合成一則未署名的留言，刊在訪談標題下，不區分這是兩個人的說法。
options.whyZh: 有標題不夠；編修後仍應看得出錄音說了什麼，以及鄰居另外提供了什麼。

options.text: Add the neighbor as a speaker on the cabinet card and print the reply there, leaving the comments sheet unchanged.
options.zh: 把鄰居加為故事櫃卡片上的講述者，將回應印在卡片上，意見單維持原樣。
options.whyZh: 鄰居寫了回應，不代表在錄音中說話；卡片講述者欄不能取代意見單。

options.text: Under the interview title, introduce Mina’s words as a quotation and give the neighbor’s later memory separately as a response.
options.zh: 在訪談標題下，把米娜的話標為引言，再把鄰居記得自己在外頭待得更久的話另列為回應。
options.whyZh: 作為獨立回應刊在標題下，清楚分開錄音中的米娜原話和鄰居自己的回憶，符合意見單規則。

explanationZh: 作為獨立回應刊在標題下，清楚分開錄音中的米娜原話和鄰居自己的回憶，符合意見單規則。
evidence: print a neighbor’s response as a separate entry that gives the story title. / which words the neighbor added and which came from the recording. / a speaker in the recording, not a byline for the comments sheet. / Neighbors can leave written comments even for a story marked “with headphones.”

vocabulary.note: unsigned 指留言沒有署名，不一定表示留言內容沒有引述別人的話。
space 在卡片上指欄位；這一欄記的是錄音可以採用什麼播放方式，不是聆聽的場所。
